name: Kemp & Co Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Kemp & Company Ltd is in the business of Real Estate, Investments and Retail Trading in hard & soft luggage[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company used to do business of manufacturing and trading of pharmaceutical products. It then started manufacturing of toys and components which was discontinued after a few years. Company later started retailing of luggage products through its outlets.
At present, company is in the business of retailing of luggage products and accessories through its retail outlet of VIP luggage in Delhi and Calcutta and it also earns rental income from its ownership of commercial property located at Mumbai

pros: Stock is trading at 0.82 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -1.06% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -0.10% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 87.8 days to 169 days
